wish: someone should make a couch-to-5k style app that teaches cooking one recipe at a time
spec:
A fixed ladder of 20 beginner recipes, each teaching one skill, from boiled eggs to a two-dish dinner.
Open it, tick off ingredients, follow four short steps, tap Mark cooked to unlock the next rung; progress is saved on the device.
It does not give nutrition advice, scale quantities, or adapt to diets.
